string_var baseID
ref base
float offsetX
float offsetY
float angle
ref item
float x
float y
float z
float bottom
float range
begin function {baseID,offsetX,offsetY,angle}
let base := StringToRef "$baseID"
let x := player.GetPos X
let y := player.GetPos Y
let z := player.GetPos Z
let x += offsetX
let y += offsetY
let z += 1000
let bottom := z - 2000
let range := GetP2PRayCastRange x y z x y bottom 6
let z := bottom + range
let item := player.PlaceAtMe base 1
item.SetPosEx x y z
item.SetAngle Z angle
SetFunctionValue item
end
